newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CAMPBELL SPEARHEADS ZIMBABWE CHARGE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CAMPBELL SPEARHEADS ZIMBABWE CHARGE.

text.p: Zimbabwe captain Alistair Campbell top scored with 86 as Zimbabwe reached 240 for eight in their one-day international against India on Sunday.
He struck two fours and two sixes in his 108-ball knock after India captain Sachin Tendulkar had asked Zimbabwe to bat first.
Campbell came to the wicket with Zimbabwe on 18 for one and combined in a 61-run stand with Grant Flower to lay the foundations for a respectable total.
Flower made 40 from 69 balls before spooning a catch to point off slow left-armer Sunil Joshi.
All-rounder Guy Whittall contributed 20 to a third wicket stand of 49 in 52 balls and then Andy Flower hit 35 in a fourth wicket stand worth 63 to put Zimbabwe in a powerful position.
India need to win the game to draw level on three points with Zimbabwe in the triangular series which also involves South Africa.
Zimbabwe have a far superior run rate to India and Tendulkar's team will have to score the runs in 40.5 overs to book a place in Wednesday's final against South Africa.
